description: Smoke task for finder_env: pre_task opens a Finder window on ~/Downloads and waits for it to register. The verifier passes when (a) the Finder process is running (trivially true — Finder is the macOS shell), AND (b) at least one Finder window is open. No agent action required — this exists to validate the env end-to-end (Finder preferences seeded, window opens at the expected path) and to give a known-good interactive view via `gym-anything run … -i --open-vnc`.
natural_language: Wait. A Finder window is opened before the agent gets control; no action is required.
